name: Natsuyasumi o Kawaii Onna no Ko de Sugosu Houhou
original_name: 夏休みを可愛い女の子で過ごす方法
source:
The second in the feminized adventure series from Bokukano collaborators Kuranosuke Chushin and Tenchi Kiguu.
Wake up to a beautiful girl's breasts atop your body - that's right, your body is now female!
Though being totally baffled, the protagonist had to go back to his home island to work in a guest house during the summer season,
to gather the lustful eyes of the tourists! He gradually gets used to see the world from a girl's viewpoint, but feeling the feminine pleasure is another thing.

On the first day of his summer vacation, Akira was waked up by his childhood friend Tomomi to find his body transformed into that of a girl!
"What the hell is going on?"
Though confused and vexed, (s)he had to fulfill his promise to help the business of a guest house in his hometown during the summer vacation.
"Well, if I can't help it..."
Akira decided to do as he vowed to his friend, to go back to his native isolated island as a friend of Tomomi.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE103082.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
这是《Bokukano》合作作者中臣藏之介与天知奇遇推出的女性化冒险系列第二作。

一觉醒来，美少女的胸部正压在你的身体上——没错，你的身体已经变成了女性！主人公虽然完全摸不着头脑，却必须在暑假回到故乡的孤岛，在民宿帮忙，并承受游客们贪婪的目光。他逐渐习惯了以女性视角看待世界，但体验女性的快感又是另一回事。

暑假第一天，明被青梅竹马友美叫醒，发现自己的身体变成了女孩。

“这到底是怎么回事？”

明既困惑又烦恼，却不得不履行约定，在暑假期间回到故乡，帮助那里的民宿生意。

“既然没办法……那就这样吧。”

明决定遵守与朋友的约定，以友美朋友的身份回到那座与世隔绝的故乡小岛。
